occurrence.description: which occurrence of the same request it answers (RT-23); operation, request and occurrence key an answer within the stream of one run, not across the type, so none carries key (KR-19, TR-28)

answer.description: the answer of the port (RT-23); an entry holds exactly one of answer and error, which the subset cannot say without a discriminator, so both are optional (G-43); any value, which the subset cannot say: closed until the kernel takes the keyword of S0-53 (G-38)

status.description: the status, where there is one

error.description: an adapter error, never a body or headers of a vendor (RT-23); in place of answer, which the subset cannot say (G-43)

billing.description: how the answer is paid for (RT-23)

usd.description: the cost in USD, only for billing api (RT-23)

mode.description: the mode of the port (RT-22, RT-23)

id.description: the model id the adapter reports

check.description: whether it was checked against the pinned one (RT-23, DP-10)

model.description: the model that answered, on every answer (RT-23, RT-25); an error has none, so it is optional, which the subset cannot tie to answer (G-43)

memo.description: the run a memo answer came from (RT-24); an event, so pin says nothing (G-42)
